outcome: Area under the curve (AUC) of phasic contractions
Expression of TRPV3 and TRPV4 isoforms
cohort: Uterine biopsies were obtained from 22 consenting women undergoing elective caesarean delivery at term without labor.
finding: Activation of TRPV4 channels by specific agonists leads to a rapid and consistent tocolytic effect on human myometrial tissue by activating BKCa channels, which hyperpolarizes the myometrial cell membrane, inactivates L-type Ca2+ channels, and efficiently abrogates contractile activity.
cross-section timing: Uterine biopsies were obtained from women at term without labor during elective caesarean delivery.
